description: Punyawathie Gunaweera v. Gertude Silva and Others Punyawathie Gunaweera v. Gertude Silva and Others View More before Hon. W.L. Ranjith Silva, J.
parties: Punyawathie Gunaweera v. Gertude Silva and Others Punyawathie Gunaweera v. Gertude Silva and Others View More
keywords: This Appeal is against dismissal of partition action on ground of prescription; whether 3rd contesting defendant possessed land as licensee or in adverse possession; birth/death certificates and rate payments (Section 3 of Prescription Ordinance) assessed; trial judge\'s findings on prescription held erroneous and not rationally evaluated; appellate court\'s power to reverse findings of fact. Held - District Court judgement set aside; Appeal allowed, and ordered to enter interlocutory decree and proceed with trial.
legistation: Section 754(1) of the Civil Procedure Code and Article 138(1) of the Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
